iconOnly.description: Draws the crumbs before the last as their icon alone. The module carries no crumb icon (a crumb's icon is a template function), so a crumb with only an icon is not possible; true hides every label but the last.

items.description: The crumbs from the first to the current page, one object each: `label` and `href`. A crumb's icon (a template function in the element) is not carried. The last crumb is the current page.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
